mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_material_effect_declaration (tenant_id, run_id, node_key, effect_index, declaration, declaration_hash, workflow_ver) VALUES (#{t}, #{runId}, #{nodeKey}, #{effectIndex}, #{declaration}::jsonb, #{hash}, #{workflowVer}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, run_id, node_key, effect_index) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO plate_material_effect (tenant_id, source_run_id, source_node_key, source_loop_index, effect_index, source_attempt, plate_id, declaration, declaration_hash, payload_hash, target_snapshot, resolution_evidence, expected_state_version, expected_process_state, expected_seal_state, status) VALUES (#{t}, #{runId}, #{nodeKey}, #{loopIndex}, #{effectIndex}, #{attempt}, #{plateId}, #{declaration}::jsonb, #{declHash}, #{payloadHash}, #{targetSnapshot}::jsonb, #{resolutionEvidence}::jsonb, #{expectedStateVersion}, #{expectedProcessState}, #{expectedSealState}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_run_id, source_node_key, source_loop_index, effect_index) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO plate_material_effect_action (tenant_id, effect_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, operator_user_id, reason, evidence_snapshot, error_code) VALUES (#{t}, #{effectId}, #{actionType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actorType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{reason}, #{evidenceSnapshot}::jsonb, #{errorCode})

INSERT INTO plate_material_event (tenant_id, plate_id, effect_id, event_type, from_process_state, to_process_state, from_seal_state, to_seal_state, changed_fields, from_state_version, to_state_version, source_run_id, source_node_key, source_loop_index, command_id, evidence, evidence_level, evidence_snapshot, operator_type, operator_user_id, note, occurred_at) VALUES (#{t}, #{plateId}, #{effectId}, #{eventType}, #{fromProcessState}, #{toProcessState}, #{fromSealState}, #{toSealState}, #{changedFields}::jsonb, #{fromStateVersion}, #{toStateVersion}, #{sourceRunId}, #{sourceNodeKey}, #{sourceLoopIndex}, #{commandId}, #{evidence}, #{evidenceLevel}, #{evidenceSnapshot}::jsonb, #{operatorType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{note}, #{occurredAt}::timestamptz)
mapper.update: UPDATE run_node SET execution_resolution_status = #{resolution}, physical_completed_at = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'completed' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, physical_evidence_level = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'completed' THEN #{physicalEvidenceLevel} ELSE NULL END, physical_evidence = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'completed' THEN #{physicalEvidence}::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND run_id = #{runId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND loop_index = 0 AND (execution_resolution_status = 'unresolved' OR execution_resolution_status IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT declaration AS "declaration", declaration_hash AS "declarationHash" FROM run_material_effect_declaration WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND run_id = #{runId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND effect_index = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS "id", state_version AS "stateVersion", position_status AS "positionStatus" FROM plate WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND barcode = #{barcode} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS "id", p.state_version AS "stateVersion", p.position_status AS "positionStatus", ps.occupied_by_run AS "occupiedByRun", ps.reserved_by_run AS "reservedByRun" FROM position_state ps JOIN plate p ON p.barcode = ps.plate_id AND p.tenant_id = ps.tenant_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{t} AND ps.resource_id = #{resourceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND source_run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED','REJECTED','NEEDS_RECONCILIATION')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM run_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND run_id = #{runId} AND level = 0 AND loop_index = 0 AND execution_resolution_status = 'reconciliation_required')

SELECT status AS "status", plate_id AS "plateId", expected_state_version AS "expectedStateVersion", expected_process_state AS "expectedProcessState", expected_seal_state AS "expectedSealState", source_run_id AS "sourceRunId", source_node_key AS "sourceNodeKey", source_loop_index AS "sourceLoopIndex", declaration AS "declaration", declaration_hash AS "declarationHash", payload_hash AS "payloadHash", last_error_code AS "lastErrorCode" FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT process_state AS "processState", seal_state AS "sealState", state_version AS "stateVersion" FROM plate WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{plateId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plate SET process_state = #{processState}, seal_state = #{sealState}, state_version = #{newStateVersion}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{plateId}
UPDATE run_node SET material_sync_status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND run_id = #{runId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND loop_index = 0
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'NEEDS_RECONCILIATION') > 0 THEN 'needs_reconciliation' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REJECTED') > 0 THEN 'rejected' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') > 0 THEN 'failed' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') > 0 THEN 'pending' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') > 0 THEN 'cancelled' WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN 'applied' ELSE 'not_required' END FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND source_run_id = #{runId} AND source_node_key = #{nodeKey}
SELECT id FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE plate_material_effect SET apply_attempt_count = apply_attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_attempt_at = now(), next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}::timestamptz, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE plate_material_effect SET status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = 'EC-MATERIAL-RETRY-EXHAUSTED', last_error_message = '重试超限，转人工', next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND apply_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}

UPDATE plate_material_effect SET plate_id = #{plateId}, expected_state_version = #{expectedStateVersion}, status = 'PENDING', resolution_evidence = resolution_evidence || jsonb_build_object('reconciled', true, 'confirmedPlateId', #{plateId}), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'NEEDS_RECONCILIATION'

UPDATE plate_material_effect SET expected_state_version = #{expectedStateVersion}, status = 'PENDING', resolution_evidence = resolution_evidence || jsonb_build_object('rebased', true), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", expected_state_version AS "expectedStateVersion", source_run_id AS "sourceRunId", source_node_key AS "sourceNodeKey" FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND plate_id = #{plateId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, action_type AS "actionType", from_status AS "fromStatus", to_status AS "toStatus", actor_type AS "actorType", operator_user_id AS "operatorUserId", reason, created_at AS "createdAt" FROM plate_material_effect_action WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND effect_id = #{effectId} ORDER BY id
SELECT count(*) FROM plate_process_state WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND code = #{code} AND enabled = true
SELECT code AS "code", display_name AS "displayName" FROM plate_process_state WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND enabled = true ORDER BY sort_order, code

SELECT p.id AS "id", p.barcode AS "barcode", p.plate_type AS "plateType", p.process_state AS "processState",
COALESCE(p.seal_state, 'none') AS "sealState", p.state_version AS "stateVersion", p.position_status AS "positionStatus", p.status AS "status", p.location_id AS "locationId", p.rows AS "rows", p.cols AS "cols", to_char(p.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS "createdAt", to_char(p.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS "updatedAt", (SELECT to_char(max(e.occurred_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') FROM plate_material_event e WHERE e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND e.plate_id = p.id) AS "lastChangedAt", (SELECT e.source_run_id FROM plate_material_event e WHERE e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND e.plate_id = p.id ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "lastRunId" FROM plate p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{t} AND p.barcode = #{barcode} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT e.id AS "id", e.event_type AS "eventType", e.from_process_state AS "fromProcessState", e.to_process_state AS "toProcessState", e.from_seal_state AS "fromSealState", e.to_seal_state AS "toSealState", e.changed_fields AS "changedFields", e.from_state_version AS "fromStateVersion", e.to_state_version AS "toStateVersion", e.source_run_id AS "sourceRunId", e.source_node_key AS "sourceNodeKey", e.source_loop_index AS "sourceLoopIndex", e.evidence AS "evidence", e.evidence_level AS "evidenceLevel", e.operator_type AS "operatorType", e.operator_user_id AS "operatorUserId", e.note AS "note", to_char(e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS "occurredAt", to_char(e.recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS "recordedAt" FROM plate_material_event e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{t} AND e.plate_id = #{plateId} ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT code AS "code", display_name AS "displayName", sort_order AS "sortOrder", enabled AS "enabled" FROM plate_process_state WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plate_process_state (tenant_id, code, display_name, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{t}, #{code}, #{displayName}, #{sortOrder}, true)
mapper.update: UPDATE plate_process_state SET display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, display_name), sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, sort_order), enabled = COALESCE(#{enabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, enabled), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND code = #{code}
